/* saleson.shop.slave.SlaveGiveStateMapper.getGiveStateDetail */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_AMT), 0) AS CNTR_AMT , COUNT(DISTINCT(USER_ID)) AS GIVE_PERSONS , IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_POINT), 0) AS CNTR_POINT FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE 1=1 AND year(GC.CNTR_DE) = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') -- 올해 AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' and GC.cntr_sttus_code = '200' and GC.sttemnt_pay_de is not NULL
AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode}
/* saleson.shop.slave.SlaveGiveStateMapper.getLocgovCodeList */ SELECT LOCGOV_CODE , LOCGOV_NM FROM G_LOCGOV WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE = #{code} AND USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY ORDERING

/* saleson.shop.slave.SlaveGiveStateMapper.getLocgovCode */ SELECT M.LOCGOV_CODE , L.LOCGOV_NM , L.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE , (SELECT LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE OCC WHERE ID = L.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AND CODE_TYPE = 'WDR' AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS UPPER_LOCGOV_NM FROM OP_MANAGER M, G_LOCGOV L WHERE 1=1 AND M.LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE AND USER_ID = #{userId}

/* saleson.shop.slave.SlaveGiveStateMapper.getGiveStateDetailListCntrUsePoint */ SELECT a.cntr_sn , a.use_sn , a.point_use_de , a.cntr_use_point , a.user_id , a.USER_NAME USER_NAME , a.LOGIN_ID LOGIN_ID , a.psitn_locgov_code , a.cntr_locgov_code , (select concat(upper_locgov_nm, ' ', locgov_nm) from g_locgov where locgov_code=a.psitn_locgov_code) as psitn_locgov_code_name , (select concat(upper_locgov_nm, ' ', locgov_nm) from g_locgov where locgov_code=a.cntr_locgov_code) as cntr_locgov_code_name , a.use_se_code , a.use_cn , a.order_code , a.url_adres , a.frst_register_id , a.frst_regist_pnttm , a.last_updusr_id , a.last_updt_pnttm FROM ( SELECT GC.cntr_sn , GC.use_sn , GC.point_use_de , GC.cntr_use_point , GC.user_id , OU.USER_NAME , OU.LOGIN_ID , GC.psitn_locgov_code , GC.cntr_locgov_code , GC.use_se_code , GC.use_cn , GC.order_code , GC.url_adres , GC.frst_register_id , GC.frst_regist_pnttm , GC.last_updusr_id , GC.last_updt_pnttm FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT GC, OP_USER OU WHERE 1=1 AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND cntr_sn = #{shCntrSn} ) a ORDER BY a.cntr_sn desc

/* saleson.shop.slave.SlaveGiveStateMapper.getGiveStateModifyInfo */ SELECT a.cntr_sn , a.user_id , a.USER_NAME USER_NAME , a.LOGIN_ID LOGIN_ID , a.elctrn_pay_no , a.sttemnt_pay_de , a.cntr_de , a.cntr_amt , (select detail from op_common_code where id = a.rtnpsnt_reqst_code and code_type = 'RTNPSNT_REQST' and use_yn = 'Y') as rtnpsnt_reqst_code , a.cntr_point , a.cntr_point - a.CNTR_USE_POINT as cntr_blce_point , (select label from op_common_code where id = a.cntr_sttus_code and code_type = 'CNTR_STTUS' and use_yn = 'Y') as cntr_sttus_code , a.delete_at , a.psitn_locgov_code , a.cntr_locgov_code , a.seoul_trget_at , a.nts_sttus_mssage , (select CONCAT(upper_locgov_nm, ' ', locgov_nm) from g_locgov where locgov_code=a.psitn_locgov_code) as psitn_locgov_code_name , (select CONCAT(upper_locgov_nm, ' ', locgov_nm) from g_locgov where locgov_code=a.cntr_locgov_code) as cntr_locgov_code_name , a.mng_no , a.CNTR_USE_POINT , a.link_instt_cd , (SELECT detail FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE code_type = 'LINK_INSTT_CD' AND id = a.link_instt_cd) detail FROM ( SELECT GC.cntr_sn , GC.user_id , OU.USER_NAME , OU.LOGIN_ID , GC.elctrn_pay_no , GC.sttemnt_pay_de , GC.cntr_de , GC.cntr_amt , GC.rtnpsnt_reqst_code , GC.cntr_point , GC.cntr_blce_point , GC.cntr_sttus_code , GC.delete_at , GC.psitn_locgov_code , GC.cntr_locgov_code , GC.seoul_trget_at , GC.nts_sttus_mssage , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GC.cntr_locgov_code,1,2) = '11' then (select to_char(sysdatetime, 'hh24missFF') || lpad(random() % 1000, 3, 0)) ELSE (select mng_htm5 from gif_stnd_buga_now where elct_pay_no = GC.elctrn_pay_no) END AS mng_no , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT),0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.CNTR_SN = GC.CNTR_SN) AS CNTR_USE_POINT , GC.link_instt_cd FROM G_CNTR GC, OP_USER OU WHERE 1=1 AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND elctrn_pay_no = #{elctrnPayNo} ) a

/* saleson.shop.slave.SlaveGiveStateMapper.giveReqmngSmsUserInfo */ SELECT a.USER_ID , a.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME , a.LOCGOV_NM , a.MBER_CI , a.CNTR_AMT , a.RECEIVE_SMS , REPLACE (a.PHONE_NUMBER,'-','') AS PHONE_NUMBER FROM ( SELECT A.USER_ID , A.USER_NAME , CONCAT(UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, ' ', LOCGOV_NM) AS LOCGOV_NM , MBER_CI , B.CNTR_AMT , D.RECEIVE_SMS , D.PHONE_NUMBER FROM OP_USER A INNER JOIN G_CNTR B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND ELCTRN_PAY_NO = #{elctrnPayNo} INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV C ON B.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = C.LOCGOV_CODE INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL D ON A.USER_ID = D.USER_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} ) a

/* saleson.shop.slave.SlaveGiveStateMapper.giveReqmngSmsUserInfoByReqId */ SELECT a.USER_ID , a.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME , a.LOCGOV_NM , a.MBER_CI , a.CNTR_AMT , a.RECEIVE_SMS , REPLACE (a.PHONE_NUMBER,'-','') AS PHONE_NUMBER FROM ( SELECT C.USER_ID , C.USER_NAME , CONCAT(D.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, ' ', D.LOCGOV_NM) AS LOCGOV_NM , MBER_CI , B.CNTR_AMT , E.RECEIVE_SMS , E.PHONE_NUMBER FROM G_CNTR_REQMNG A INNER JOIN G_CNTR B ON A.CNTR_SN = B.CNTR_SN INNER JOIN OP_USER C ON B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV D ON B.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = D.LOCGOV_CODE INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL E ON C.USER_ID = E.USER_ID WHERE A.REQ_ID = #{reqId} ) a
/* saleson.shop.slave.SlaveGiveStateMapper.getCntrUsePointCheck */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT WHERE CNTR_SN = #{cntrSn}

SELECT A.ELCTRN_PAY_NO , A.STTEMNT_PAY_DE , A.CNTR_AMT , (SELECT LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'NTS_CODE' AND ID = A.ELCR_APL_CD) AS ELCR_APL_CD , A.NTS_RES_CODE , A.NTS_RES_MSSAGE , A.CONB_CD , A.CNTR_TYPE , A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM ( SELECT ELCTRN_PAY_NO , STTEMNT_PAY_DE , CNTR_AMT , ELCR_APL_CD , NTS_RES_CODE , NTS_RES_MSSAGE , CONB_CD , CNTR_TYPE , TO_CHAR(FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , TO_CHAR(LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM G_CNTR_TAX_LOG WHERE ELCTRN_PAY_NO = #{elctrnPayNo} ) A ORDER BY A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC
